# Strategic Account Engagement Kit & Risk Fact Sheet

Last updated: 2026-02-20
Owner: Go-to-Market (Eleanor Kim)
Purpose: Single-page, field-ready kit for AE/SE teams engaging strategic prospects that need clear positioning, a competitive brief, pricing scenarios, a short pitch-deck outline, a case study excerpt, and a security FAQ tailored for procurement and infosec review.

---

## 1) One-line positioning and 30-second elevator
- Positioning: Redwood Inference provides production-grade LLM inference that makes latency, cost, and reliability predictable across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.
- 30s elevator: "We help engineering teams ship LLM features without wrestling with GPUs, variable latency, or runaway costs — whether you want a hosted API, dedicated capacity, or a private on-prem deployment with enterprise controls and SLAs."

## 2) Differentiated messaging by buyer persona
- Engineering lead / ML platform: "Same API across cloud/private, strong observability, and batching/quantization recommendations to reduce token cost — integrates with your existing CI and model packaging."
- CTO / Head of Product: "Predictable unit economics and graceful fallbacks keep the customer-facing product stable while controlling infra spend."
- Security / Infosec: "Private deployment options, KMS/HSM integration, audit logs, and documented evidence packages for SOC/ISO reviews."
- Procurement / Legal: "Flexible commercial models: usage-based hosted + reserved, with enterprise support and clear SLAs for dedicated/private contracts."

## 3) One-page competitive brief (quick-read)
Competitors: Major cloud AI endpoints, LLM API providers, and self-hosted runtime vendors.
- Key Redwood differentiators:
  - Unified runtime for hosted/dedicated/private: customers avoid divergent stacks when moving to private.
  - Cost controls: intelligent batching, prefix caching, and quantization profiles recommended per workload.
  - Reliability primitives: automated model fallbacks, region routing, and SLA-backed dedicated pools.
  - Observability and rollouts: token-level costing, per-route dashboards, and canary/A-B rollout primitives built-in.
- Typical competitor objections and counters:
  1) "We can run models ourselves": counter — running is easy; operating a predictable, economical inference layer at scale with SLAs is not. Offer a pilot with hybrid (hosted + canary to private) to prove economics.
  2) "Cloud vendor has deeper discounts": counter — Redwood can optimize model/runtime to reduce unit costs and provides deployment flexibility that cloud-managed endpoints often lack.

## 4) Short pitch deck — slide-by-slide bullets (for SE/AE delivery)
1. Title & Pain: Low-level latency spikes, cost variability, and deployment friction.
2. Solution overview: Redwood product modes + runtime highlights.
3. Architecture sketch: smart routing, caching, and dedicated pools.
4. Real metrics: median p99 latency, token-cost reduction examples (from customer pilots).
5. Deployment paths: hosted -> dedicated -> private (with rollback/fallback examples).
6. Pricing approach: usage-based hosted + committed capacity options for dedicated.
7. Security & compliance: KMS, audit logging, network controls, and evidence packages.
8. Pilot proposal & success criteria: sample scope, timelines, and acceptance metrics.

## 5) Pricing guidance (field cheat-sheet)
- Pricing model summary (for conversation):
  - Hosted API: per-token (generations & embeddings) with free tier and monthly credits for pilots.
  - Dedicated: monthly reserved capacity (GPU-backed pools) with defined throughput and SLA.
  - Private: platform license + services (onboarding, packaging, optional air-gapped deployment).

- Typical pilot packages (recommended):
  1) 6-week hosted pilot: $0 flat pilot credits up to 50M tokens, success criteria (latency <200ms median, error rate <1%).
  2) 90-day POC (hybrid): dedicated trial nodes + hosted fallback; recommended commitment: 3 months reserved capacity for predictable load testing.

- Pricing scenarios (estimates for qualification):
  | Scenario | Avg QPS | Avg Seq Len (tokens) | Est. Monthly Tokens | Recommended Plan | Est. Monthly Cost (USD) |
  |---|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|
  | Small feature pilot | 10 | 150 | 6.5M | Hosted (pay-as-you-go) | $1,200 |
  | High-volume chat product | 200 | 300 | 1.56B | Dedicated (reserved) | $75,000 |
  | Regulated enterprise (on-prem) | 50 | 250 | 112.5M | Private + support | $40,000+ (license + services) |

Notes: These are starting-point estimates for qualification only. Provide a deeper TCO after an initial traffic trace and prompt-profile review. Emphasize that model selection/quantization can materially change costs.

## 6) Case study excerpt (1-paragraph, field-ready)
Customer: FinServe Inc. (anonymized)
Problem: Production chat agent faced 2–3s p95 latency spikes and unpredictable token spend during peak volume.
Solution: Redeployed inference through Greenwood's Redwood Dedicated pool with prefix caching, reduced batching latency with request priorities, and quantized model variant for non-sensitive traffic.
Outcome: p95 latency reduced from 2.8s -> 420ms, monthly inference spend down 36% with preserved answer quality per their evaluation set. Pilot -> production in 9 weeks.
(Use this excerpt to demonstrate economic impact and operational velocity.)

## 7) Security FAQ (top questions we get from prospects)
1) Q: Can Redwood run in our VPC/on-prem?
   A: Yes. Redwood Private supports customer-managed VPCs and an on-prem package for air-gapped deployments. We provide deployment manifests and an installation runbook; professional services available for initial install.
2) Q: How do you manage keys and secrets?
   A: We integrate with customer KMS providers and support HSM-backed key stores. For Private deployments, keys remain in-customer control.
3) Q: Is there audit logging and evidence for compliance reviews?
   A: Yes. We provide structured audit logs for API calls, model versioning events, rollout actions, and admin changes. We maintain a compliance evidence bundle for SOC2/ISO requests.
4) Q: How do you guarantee data isolation with Dedicated?
   A: Dedicated pools are tenant-isolated at the orchestration and network layer. We provide network-level controls and per-tenant storage isolation for persisted artifacts.
5) Q: What is your incident response process and SLAs?
   A: For Dedicated and Private customers we offer SLA-backed uptime guarantees, 24/7 support for P1 incidents, and runbooks for escalation. Refer to the contract SLA section and our incident-response runbook.
6) Q: Do you retain or use customer prompts/responses?
   A: By default, short-lived inference logs are stored for 7 days for debugging; retention policies can be shortened or disabled and retained logs can be encrypted with customer keys. For Private deployments, no logs leave the customer environment unless configured.

## 8) Five-minute objection handling cheat-sheet
- "Your costs are higher than cloud-managed endpoints": highlight total cost of ownership (latency + errors + engineering ops). Offer a quick pilot to compare end-to-end costs.
- "We can self-host for cheaper": ask about operational burden, SLOs, and staffing; propose a hybrid approach to reduce risk.
- "We need compliance evidence": surface the compliance evidence bundle and offer a security workshop with Redwood security.

## 9) Engagement playbook — step-by-step (recommended cadence)
1. Discovery (Week 0): collect traffic trace, prompt set, security requirements. Owner: AE/SE.
2. Proposal (Week 1): tailored pricing scenarios + pilot plan with success criteria.
3. Pilot kickoff (Week 2): provide sandbox keys/region and run sample workload.
4. Measurement (Weeks 2–6): run evals for latency, quality regression, and cost metrics.
5. Review & decision (End week 6): present results, recommend deployment mode.
6. Contract & onboarding (Weeks 7–10): finalize reserved capacity or Private terms and begin production migration.
7. Post-launch (30–90 days): cost tuning, observability dashboards, and QoS guardrails.

## 10) Sales assets & playbook links (fast access)
- One-pager: internal link to product-overview deck (attach to email).
- Pilot request template: use PR template ID: sales/pilot-request-template-v2.
- Security evidence bundle: contact security@redwood-inference.com for package and NDA procedure.
